abstract: In short, the comparison of the arms gives these main findings. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Alvenor reduces side effects compared with Standard care. conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care. section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Harbor Street Patients.
